design_provenance.claim: The generic complete-protonation route was developed after the prior assigned-proton coverage blocker was known; this is not a pre-disclosure or untouched-data hypothesis.
design_provenance.execution_independence: The uniform OpenMM algorithm and force field apply to every listed source support without access to assigned-atom identities, fold roles, target values, eligibility rows, or scores.
design_provenance.holdout_support_rule: Support index 1 is development-only because its target-unread result informed selection of ff15ipq. Any later all-support qualification must report index 1 only as a frozen consistency replay and must define new qualification evidence over untouched support indices 2 through 1000.
design_provenance.later_coverage_gate: Any assigned-atom coverage claim requires a separately frozen identity-only recount after these support bytes are immutable.

execution_contract.checker: independently regenerates every state in a fresh process and byte-compares the emitted PDB before sealing each shard
execution_contract.generation: one stored deterministic gzip-compressed PDB per support-condition state
execution_contract.runtime: hash-bound Singularity image with networking disabled
execution_contract.qualification_release: The first external source commitment and release are bounded-smoke-only, must exact-bind the reviewed Git commit, source hash, runtime SIF, and an externally supplied execution-release hash, and must name exactly one observed-condition entity. Full qualification requires a new implementation, source commitment, and release after the smoke is sealed and reviewed.

input_access_policy.catalog_projection: The exact-bound runtime_input_projection is the only catalog/condition artifact the generator may deserialize.
input_access_policy.runtime_pdb_rule: The worker may read only this committed-relative path derived from the frozen projection through the launcher's fixed read-only BioEmu mount and must hash-check raw bytes before parsing.

openmm_policy.parent_heavy_atoms: exact ordered atom identity and 0.001-A parsed coordinate preservation
openmm_policy.randomness: candidate/entity/support/branch SHA256-derived seed with isolated process and every exposed RNG seeded
openmm_policy.unsupported_residue_or_template: fail the entire candidate without entity or residue exception

qualification_condition_branches.observed: one observed-0 branch using the exact deposited_ph string
qualification_condition_branches.use_in_final_support_mapping: Qualification materializes all five possible states per unresolved parent support. A later target-unread diversity/order commitment selects exactly one frozen branch per ranked support using the already frozen balanced mapping rule; this plan does not define the final support ensemble.

output_contract.compression: gzip.compress(raw_pdb, compresslevel=9, mtime=0) under the hash-bound Python runtime; raw decompressed PDB hash remains canonical

entity_archive_members.metadata: metadata.jsonl: one ASCII JSON object per line, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False, exactly one LF after every row, sorted by support_index then condition_branch_id

output_contract.entity_archive_serialization: uncompressed tarfile.USTAR_FORMAT with lexically sorted members, exactly two 512-byte zero end blocks, mtime/uid/gid=0, uname/gname empty, mode 0444; each PDB member is gzip-compressed with compresslevel=9, mtime=0, and no filename
output_contract.pdb_serialization: OpenMM PDBFile.writeModel(topology, positions, ASCII text, modelIndex=None, keepIds=True) followed by PDBFile.writeFooter; no writeFile wall-clock header; LF line endings under the pinned Linux container

policy_lineage.predecessor_condition_policy_use: condition classification, deposited pH values, unresolved regime boundaries/midpoints, hydrogen stripping, variants=None, Reference platform, deterministic isolation, replay, physicality, and shared-q separation only
policy_lineage.superseded_field: amber14/protein.ff14SB.xml is replaced uniformly by amber14/protein.ff15ipq.xml under this separately named candidate
policy_lineage.supersession_evidence: The target-unread ff14SB support-1 route failed closed on standard NASH template coverage; the bound ff15ipq template scan covered all 199 support-1 condition states, and the bound support-1 result later passed complete physicality. Neither result establishes all-support behavior.
policy_lineage.unchanged_authorization_rule: No predecessor authorization is reusable; this HOLD plan cannot request or consume authorization.

roster.observed_state_rule: one exact deposited-pH state per coordinate support
roster.support_missingness_rule: Qualify every support row present in the exact-bound catalog, preserve each catalog missing-index set, and neither impute nor renumber absent BioEmu indexes.
roster.unresolved_state_rule: five frozen pH-regime midpoint qualification candidates per coordinate support; not five final support members

scope_limits: qualification and complete-coordinate asset construction only
no support ordering, diversity, exact-nesting, source-gate, sampling-sufficiency, science, CCC, or formal-evaluation claim
PASS from the static validator means only that this unexecuted HOLD plan is internally consistent
support index 1 is outcome-informed development evidence and may be replayed only as a consistency check; untouched indices 2 through 1000 define any later new all-support qualification evidence
the committed implementation in this stage supports only the one-observed-entity bounded smoke; no full-cohort runner or aggregate result is supplied or implied
proposal pH branches and support weights are not posterior q
stage_order: replay the frozen minimal runtime input projection and deny generator access to provenance-only inputs
implement generator and separately authored checker
obtain independent pre-smoke cold GO on the implementation and frozen inputs
freeze executable source and every transitive input in an external O_EXCL commitment
obtain an external hash-bound bounded-smoke execution release
run bounded target-unread performance and storage smoke
obtain independent final cold GO on the exact source commitment
independently replay each shard and seal complete aggregate evidence
only then update all-atom support feasibility state
freeze exact target-unread support order, diversity thresholds, and K32/K128/K768 nesting
run a separately frozen identity-only assigned-atom coverage recount
create a separate science commitment, obtain independent review, and request fresh one-shot authorization only if every prior gate passes
